newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ball Corp to buy MC Packaging.
newsitem.headline: Ball Corp to buy MC Packaging.

text.p: FTB Packaging Ltd, a unit of Ball Corp of the United States, said on Friday it had reached a conditional agreement to buy a controlling stake in M.C. Packaging (Hong Kong) Ltd from Lam Soon (HK) Ltd.

It said after the acquisition it would control directly and indirectly 51.2 percent of M.C. Packaging's voting rights and would then launch a possible cash offer for the remaining shares at HK$2.80 per share.
FTB Packaging said it had agreed to buy 5,805 shares of Fung Shun Investment Co Ltd, which controls 50.23 percent of M.C. Packaging, from Lam Soon for HK$94,080 per share.
Lam Soon also agreed to sell 6.5 million shares, or 0.97 percent of M.C. Packaging, to FTB for HK$2.80 per share, giving FTB control of 51.2 percent of M.C. Packaging's voting rights.
Total consideration for the offer is HK$564.34 million.
Completion of the sale is conditional on Ng Fung Hong (Holdings) Ltd waiving its right to first refusal for Fung Shun shares. Ng Fung holds 41.95 percent of Fung Shun.
The sale is also conditional upon approval of the shareholders of Lam Soon, who have until December 22 to agree to the sale.

The offer values the whole of M.C. Packaging at HK$1.87 billion, and the offer price of HK$2.80 per share represents a premium of 8.7 percent to the closing market price of the shares of HK$2.575 on November 6, the last traded price of the shares prior to their suspension on November 7.
The shares will resume trading on Friday, November 8.

Ball Corp is listed in the United States. Its principal activities are the manufacture of two-piece metal beverage cans and other rigid metal and plastic packaging for foods and beverages, and the provision of aerospace and other technology products and services to government and commercial customers.
The U.S. company intends to maintain M.C. Packaging's Hong Kong listing, the company said.
M.C. Packaging manufactures two-piece aluminum cans, three- piece tin containers, plastic bottles and closures.
